summary.text: Robert Jones is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 44, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

A retired systems and software engineer from Goffstown, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he supports restoring higher corporate taxes and the Interest and Dividends Tax to reduce reliance on property taxes.

paragraphs.text: Robert Jones earned a bachelor's degree from Bowdoin College in 1964 and a graduate degree from Stanford University in 1978, according to Ballotpedia, and worked as a systems engineer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a retired systems and software engineer who has lived in Goffstown since 2014 and has been active at St. Matthew's Episcopal church since 1987.

He said he wants to restore compassion and decency in the State House, reverse what he called the defunding of public institutions, particularly public education, and replace the statewide education property tax with another funding method.
He listed AFT-NH as an endorser.
